focus_areas: Branch connectivity and topology (ensure no fused or floating limbs).
Texture consistency from base to tip (check for AI smoothing).
Grounding interface and base convergence plausibility.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'melting' effect often seen in AI-generated organic clusters. Specifically, check if the branches maintain distinct cylindrical volumes throughout their length or if they flatten/merge unnaturally near the center of the cluster. Verify that the lighting direction is consistent across the complex 3D form. Crucially, ensure the topology auditor uses the bounding box from the open vocabulary detector to avoid segmenting background debris as part of the fungus.
image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a coral fungus (Ramaria species) growing on a forest floor covered in dry leaves and twigs. The fungus features a dense cluster of upright, cylindrical branches that are pale orange to cream-colored, with slightly darker tips. The background is softly blurred (bokeh), emphasizing the intricate branching structure of the subject.
